purpose: Freeze the common behavioral subset, parameter transforms, timing alignment rules, field comparability classes, and scenario-generation constraints before M13.4 observes Catalyst differential outputs.
authority_rules: This specification is a thesis-project normalization authority, not a claim about undocumented Intel Loihi microarchitecture.
Published Loihi evidence remains the authority for claims about Loihi itself; Brian2Loihi and Catalyst are independent implementations/interpretations.
Transforms are frozen before M13.4 output inspection and must not be changed merely to make implementations agree.
Native configuration and native traces must be retained beside normalized artifacts.
A field marked qualitative or non_comparable must never be coerced into an exact equality test.

comparison_categories.exact: Same architectural quantity and same integer representation at the normalized boundary; equality may be tested directly.
comparison_categories.transformed: Same intended architectural quantity after the exact predeclared parameter, state-unit, identifier, or tick transform in this specification.
comparison_categories.qualitative: Related behavior can be described or ordered, but the available interfaces do not justify integer equality.
comparison_categories.non_comparable: No defensible common observable exists at this boundary; preserve native evidence only.

canonical_boundary.time: One committed target-neuron algorithmic update. Hardware clock cycles and internal FSM phases are not canonical time.
canonical_boundary.state_unit: One integer unit of the project's effective current/voltage representation. No hidden rescaling is applied to Catalyst potential/current or effective weights.
canonical_boundary.spike: Binary spike presence for a logical neuron on one canonical tick. Native spike payload is outside the common exact subset.
canonical_boundary.logical_neuron_id: Zero-based logical neuron identifier. Shared single-core/K26-portable scenarios restrict IDs to 0..255.
canonical_boundary.effective_weight: Signed integer current contribution after any source-format initialization transform. Source encoding fields remain native metadata.
canonical_boundary.refractory_duration: Number of canonical ticks from a spike tick t to the first tick on which the neuron is eligible to spike again; next_eligible_tick = t + R.

state_observation_envelope.reason: Catalyst's exposed probe/parameter/weight boundary is 16-bit even where internal current/potential memories are wider.

threshold_domain.reason: Brian2Loihi threshold_v_mant maps by x64; Catalyst strict-threshold normalization requires native threshold T+1 to remain signed-int16 representable.

legacy_effective_weight_domain.reason: Common legacy project/Brian mapping uses exponent 0 and scale 64 with Brian inhibitory mantissa -256 and excitatory mantissa +255; Catalyst accepts the resulting value directly as int16.

refractory_duration_domain.reason: Brian2Loihi exposes refractory=1..64; Catalyst native counter is transformed as R-1.

project_fpga_v1.native_boundary: ComparisonScenario/Python golden model and physically validated FPGA-v1 architectural trace

brian2loihi_0_5_2.profile: point-neuron v/I model; static Loihi-style weight initialization; Brian schedule retained

catalyst_cpu_sync.role: pinned Catalyst software reference for simple synchronous LIF/refractory/recurrent questions
catalyst_cpu_sync.native_boundary: sdk/neurocore/simulator.py synchronous DELIVER -> UPDATE -> LEARN path
catalyst_cpu_sync.profile: simple subtractive-leak LIF; no independently observable dual current state

catalyst_rtl_cuba.role: pinned Catalyst RTL boundary for dual current/potential decay questions
catalyst_rtl_cuba.profile: 24-bit internal current/potential, 12-bit decay_u/decay_v, signed 16-bit external current/weight/parameter interface

threshold.brian2loihi_0_5_2: threshold_v_mant = T / 64; T must be divisible by 64
threshold.catalyst_cpu_sync: native_threshold = T + 1 because Catalyst uses >= and normalized states are integer-valued
threshold.catalyst_rtl_cuba: native_threshold = T + 1 because the pinned RTL uses >=

reset.canonical_semantics: hard reset to zero after a spike

refractory.canonical_semantics: after a spike on tick t, first eligible tick is t + R
refractory.project_fpga_v1: refractory_ticks = R; project stores max(R-1,0) future blocked ticks
refractory.catalyst_cpu_sync: native refrac parameter = R - 1 for shared R in 1..64
refractory.catalyst_rtl_cuba: native refractory counter parameter low 8 bits = R - 1; absolute mode
refractory.normalized_observable: next_eligible_tick rather than raw implementation register

legacy_effective_weight.brian2loihi_0_5_2: mantissa = W / 64, exponent = 0, precision = 8, excitatory mode for W >= 0 and inhibitory mode for W < 0
legacy_effective_weight.catalyst_cpu_sync: native connection/direct-current value = W when the selected scenario class exposes that boundary

encoded_weight.canonical_semantics: compare final effective weight and resulting drive, not native source encoding fields
encoded_weight.project_fpga_v1: preserve requested mantissa, exponent, precision, sign mode, quantized mantissa, unclipped value, final effective value
encoded_weight.brian2loihi_0_5_2: program the same requested Loihi-style fields and observe w_act
encoded_weight.catalyst_cpu_sync: program only the final effective weight if it fits signed int16
encoded_weight.catalyst_rtl_cuba: program only the final effective weight if it fits signed int16

decay.canonical_semantics: coefficient d denotes a /4096 decay amount; project/Brian domain is 0..4096
decay.catalyst_cpu_sync: non_comparable: simple CPU LIF has subtractive leak instead of independent current/voltage decay
decay.catalyst_rtl_cuba: native decay_u/decay_v = d with shared representable domain 0..4095; at least one CUBA-enabling field must be nonzero
decay.full_decay_4096: outside Catalyst RTL common subset because decay memories are 12-bit

logical_identifiers.canonical_semantics: compare logical graph identity, not raw memory addresses or route encodings
logical_identifiers.project_fpga_v1: logical neuron IDs remain canonical; axon/route IDs are preserved only as native evidence
logical_identifiers.brian2loihi_0_5_2: logical neuron/source indices are mapped bijectively
logical_identifiers.catalyst_cpu_sync: logical neurons map to one core local IDs; synthetic driver IDs, if used, are implementation-only
logical_identifiers.catalyst_rtl_cuba: logical neurons map to one core local IDs

committed_tick.project_fpga_v1: trace tick t is canonical tick t
committed_tick.brian2loihi_0_5_2: one completed LoihiNetwork 1 ms step is treated as one candidate canonical tick; schedule-internal phases remain native evidence
committed_tick.catalyst_cpu_sync: one completed synchronous Simulator timestep is canonical tick t for direct-current-equivalent scenarios

catalyst_rtl_cuba_isolated_impulse.precondition: one non-empty external impulse at canonical tick 0 followed only by zero-input ticks over the compared window
catalyst_rtl_cuba_isolated_impulse.native_input_rule: apply the impulse before Catalyst native timestep 0
catalyst_rtl_cuba_isolated_impulse.native_observation_rule: Catalyst native timestep 0 is preserved as a warmup/staging tick and is not compared; canonical tick k maps to Catalyst native tick k+1
catalyst_rtl_cuba_isolated_impulse.reason: pinned Catalyst CUBA writes new input into current on one timestep while voltage uses the previously stored current
catalyst_rtl_cuba_isolated_impulse.scope: isolated impulse/decay traces only; do not use this shift to normalize arbitrary multi-input schedules

recurrent_delivery.canonical_observable: lag from source spike tick to first target state effect/spike
recurrent_delivery.project_fpga_v1: next-tick only by frozen route-bank contract
recurrent_delivery.catalyst_cpu_sync: previous-timestep pending spikes are delivered before UPDATE in the next synchronous timestep
recurrent_delivery.brian2loihi_0_5_2: use native recurrent LoihiSynapses with delay=0 and measure the observed lag; do not post-hoc shift the result
recurrent_delivery.catalyst_rtl_cuba: measure native routed-delivery lag at committed timestep boundaries

cpu_direct_drive.purpose: threshold/reset/refractory and delivered-drive probes where Catalyst CPU lacks an external axon-current state
requirements: current_decay must be 4096 so project/Brian current does not carry into later ticks
voltage_decay must be 0 because Catalyst CPU simple LIF has no multiplicative voltage decay
no repeated copy of one source axon within the same tick for Brian2Loihi participation
cpu_direct_drive.catalyst_translation: collapse each canonical external-axon event row into the exact per-target effective current sum and inject that sum directly before the Catalyst CPU timestep
cpu_direct_drive.topology_caveat: This scenario class compares delivered drive and neuron behavior; it does not claim that Catalyst traversed the same external-axon fanout structure.

rtl_cuba_isolated_impulse.purpose: dual current/potential decay and input-staging probes
requirements: exactly one non-empty external impulse tick at canonical tick 0
all later compared ticks have no external input
every decay is 0..4095 and at least one decay is nonzero
all direct injected per-neuron currents fit signed int16
all observed normalized states must stay inside signed int16 probe envelope
rtl_cuba_isolated_impulse.catalyst_translation: program decay_v param 16, decay_u param 17, strict-threshold-transformed param 0, absolute refractory param 3, scale_u_enable=0, and apply the canonical impulse through ext_current before native timestep 0

logical_recurrent.purpose: compare next-tick recurrence using logical neuron-to-neuron effective edges rather than raw project axon-route storage
logical_recurrent.project_translation: flatten each source_neuron -> target_axon route followed by that axon's synapse row into ordered logical (source_neuron,target_neuron,effective_weight) edges
logical_recurrent.brian2loihi_translation: instantiate recurrent LoihiSynapses for the flattened logical edges with native delay=0
logical_recurrent.catalyst_translation: instantiate same-core sparse logical connections in synchronous mode with delay=0
logical_recurrent.comparison_rule: compare source spike tick, first target-effect lag, target state/spike outcomes, and multiplicity where representable; do not compare raw CSR addresses, route slots, or global FIFO order

common_behavior_decisions.current_based_lif: conditional: project/Brian dual-state directly; Catalyst CPU only voltage/spike direct-drive subset; Catalyst RTL CUBA for dual-state probes
common_behavior_decisions.positive_negative_synaptic_drive: included by effective integer drive; Catalyst source-format encoding is not compared
common_behavior_decisions.current_voltage_decay: included through project/Brian and Catalyst RTL CUBA isolated-impulse profile; arbitrary multi-input update order remains an M13.4 architectural probe
common_behavior_decisions.threshold_reset: included with Catalyst threshold +1 transform and common reset zero
common_behavior_decisions.refractory_timing: included through normalized next_eligible_tick and Catalyst R-1 parameter transform
common_behavior_decisions.static_fixed_point_weights: included at final effective signed weight; Loihi-style encoding fields are project/Brian-only
common_behavior_decisions.fan_in_fan_out: included at logical edge multiset and delivered target sum; raw storage and external transport are not equated
common_behavior_decisions.multi_tick_state_evolution: included within each declared scenario class and field policy
common_behavior_decisions.recurrent_motifs: conditionally included in synchronous single-core, delay=0 logical-edge form; native lag is measured rather than assumed
common_behavior_decisions.finite_width_overflow: excluded from common exact subset and retained as architecture-specific native evidence

explicit_exclusions: programmable synaptic delays beyond the zero/minimal recurrent timing probe
global coincident-event total ordering where not exposed by every backend
performance, power, resource, and hardware-cycle comparisons

m13_4_handoff.rule: M13.4 must consume this frozen schema/version and may not silently substitute a different threshold, refractory, decay, weight, identifier, or timing transform.
m13_4_handoff.classification_deferred: A-H discrepancy adjudication remains M13.6; M13.4 records reproducible agreements/differences without mutating the M12 baseline.
